sources: 'Starting October 28th and fully resolving on October 31st, Roblox experienced a 73-hour outage.' · 'Fifty million players regularly use Roblox every day' (=하루 사용자 수, 못 들어온 수 아님) — https://about.roblox.com/newsroom/2022/01/roblox-return-to-service-10-28-10-31-2021/ (22:26·22:29 원문 확인)

'On October 27th at 14:00, one day before the outage, we enabled this feature on a backend service that is responsible for traffic routing… increased the number of nodes supporting traffic routing by 50%' — 같은 글

'Under very high load – specifically, both a very high read load and a very high write load – the design of streaming exacerbates the amount of contention on a single Go channel, which causes blocking during writes.' — 같은 글
'This 4.2GB log store is only storing 489MB of actual data… 3.8GB is empty space' — 같은 글
'Critical monitoring systems that would have provided better visibility … relied on affected systems, such as Consul.' — 같은 글
'split some critical services into their own dedicated clusters' · 'already built out the servers and networking for an additional, geographically distinct data center' — 같은 글
2023 셀 구조 글(about.roblox.com 2023-12)은 22:29 에 502 로 원문 확인 실패 → 화면에서 뺐다(숫자 원칙 9)
